name: The Acerone of the Madonie

location.address: Piano Ciminnita - Serra Circio, Parco delle Madonie, Castelbuono

official_register.name: Elenco degli alberi monumentali d'Italia (MASAF), sheet 10/C067/PA/19

access: Open mountain land in the Parco delle Madonie, about 1600 m; reached on foot only. A published loop 'la via dei Giganti' (about 9.4 km, 617 m climb) starts at Piano Sempria and passes the Catagiddebbe and Ciminnita maples; a park route description says the park gives no signed directions to the Acerone itself. Mountain walk, not a stroll; snow possible in winter.
transport: Rural; by car to Piano Sempria above Castelbuono (distance not checked), then on foot. No public transport.
verify_notes: Identity caution: MASAF row 10/C067/PA/19 is Acer pseudoplatanus girth 950 cm height 20 m at 'Piano Ciminnita - Serra Circio' (37.90994,14.04815). The Acerone (ilregistrodeglialberi #13205, 1612 m, 'dolina above Serra Circio', age about 905 years, health 'sufficient', last update 29/12/2024, 3 measurements, relevance international) is very probably the same tree, but no source states the MASAF sheet number, so treat as probable. A wikiloc description of the 'Ciminnita maple' gives 6.1 m girth, 12 m, about 450 years: a separate, smaller tree on the same loop, hence age_min 450 here only as a floor; the 905 figure is the register site's estimate, not measured (a park route page says 'about 900 years', 19 m base diameter, 'largest mountain maple in Italy', unverified). Notes of field recorders: very wide root base with fused roots, in a sinkhole with a view to the Aeolian Islands; lost its two biggest primary limbs (one fell at least 14 years ago, the second after 2014). Alive as of the Dec 2024 register update; no photo or GPS fix found. Recognise: a huge, broad-based maple with fused roots standing in a hollow (dolina). Pin approximate: register point only, mountain trail with no signed route.
hold: location cannot be stated honestly: a doline at 1612 m with no signed route and only the register point; needs a trail track or a GPS fix
